entry.title: Dimensional Crossover and Correlated Spin Dynamics in the Chain-Like van der Waals Antiferromagnet AgCrP$_2$S$_6$
entry.summary:
We report a comprehensive investigation of the magnetic properties and spin dynamics of the chain-like van der Waals antiferromagnet AgCrP$_2$S$_6$ using magnetization, magnetic susceptibility, and $^{31}$P nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR). The magnetic susceptibility exhibits a broad maximum near 250 K, characteristic of strong short-range antiferromagnetic correlations in a low-dimensional system. A classical Fisher-chain analysis gives an effective intrachain exchange scale $J/k_B\approx 140$ K, while a quantum $S=3/2$ nearest-neighbor-chain calculation yields $J/k_B\approx 114$ K.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #materials-science

entry.title: Quantum-Assisted Counterfactual Regret Minimization for Bounded-Payoff Imperfect-Information Games
entry.summary:
Imperfect-information games with a graded-reward structure present significant computational challenges for equilibrium computation, since the payoff expectations must be estimated across exponentially large strategy spaces. Counterfactual Regret Minimization over the years has proven effective for approximating Nash equilibria, but Monte Carlo variants create a large overhead of sampling costs when the counterfactual values are estimated from sampled game-tree trajectories. We propose a novel Quantum-Assisted Counterfactual Regret Minimization, a framework that uses Quantum Amplitude Estimation to reduce the computational complexity of the regret updates in bounded-payoff imperfect-information games, while preserving the convergence of its classical counterpart.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #decision-theory #infosec

entry.title: Operational limits of reference renewal for retained quantum-service results
entry.summary:
We implement reference renewal to reconsider retained physical quantum-service results under a prespecified protocol. Twelve transitions retained six results each; ten completed renewal, eight met the prespecified endpoint, and five succeeded using retained results alone. The exact one-sided p=0.0546875 does not establish the recovery hypothesis.

Source: arXiv CS (PL, SE, DB, DC, DS) · Tags: #compilers #distributed-systems #quantum-computing #software-architecture

entry.title: Secure Information Flow in Quantum Programs. Information-flow security aims to prevent the leakage of confidential information through program execution.
entry.summary:
Information-flow security aims to prevent the leakage of confidential information through program execution. This problem becomes fundamentally subtler for quantum programs, because their states may involve superposition and entanglement, and their executions may involve intricate interactions between classical and quantum variables. This paper develops semantic foundations and verification methods for secure information flow in quantum programs.

Source: arXiv CS (PL, SE, DB, DC, DS) · Tags: #compilers #distributed-systems #quantum-computing #cryptography

entry.title: Optimal learning of quantum channels in diamond distance
entry.summary:
Nature Physics, Published online: 12 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03499-7 Quantum channels can be used to describe the evolution of quantum states, including both unitary evolution and measurement. Now the optimal number of uses needed to learn an unknown channel to any fixed accuracy has been found.

Source: Nature Physics · Tags: #quantum-physics #optics-photonics

entry.title: Altermagnetism in a new light
entry.summary:
Nature Physics, Published online: 11 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03532-9 Altermagnets host spin-split bands despite zero net magnetization. A photonic crystal now reproduces this symmetry-driven phenomenon using circular polarization as a spin analogue.
